players.product: NIPSCO GenCo generation and electric service built under IURC-approved special contracts and PPAs for Amazon and Alphabet data centers in Indiana

quarterly_data.signal: 10-Q: NiSource expects to make capital investments of approximately $600 million in connection with Pool Resource Assets (generation assets owned or contracted by NIPSCO and/or affiliates, primarily GenCo, designed to serve data center customers) initially being developed in connection with contracted demand from data center customers; these are incremental to the data center capital investment estimates in its 2025 10-K.
quarterly_data.figure: ~$600 million incremental Pool Resource Assets capex

quarterly_data.signal: 10-Q: GenCo entered into a battery energy-storage supply agreement, of which approximately $122.7 million is a noncancelable commitment as of June 30, 2026. In August 2026 NIPSCO and GenCo filed applications with FERC seeking authorization for affiliate transactions between GenCo and NIPSCO to serve Amazon and Alphabet; FERC orders are expected in the fourth quarter of 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: $122.7 million noncancelable battery storage supply commitment; FERC orders expected Q4 2026

quarterly_data.signal: 10-Q: NIPSCO Electric Q2 2026 revenue was $572.5 million versus $493.7 million a year earlier (six months: $1,124.6 million versus $994.9 million); Q2 electric sales were 4,147.9 GWh versus 4,021.2 GWh, with industrial sales of 2,246.2 GWh versus 2,034.0 GWh.
quarterly_data.figure: NIPSCO Electric Q2 revenue $572.5 million (vs $493.7 million); 4,147.9 GWh sold
